subject.title: fix(trajectory): session.ended timestamp matches model.completed before cleanup

question: After directly checking the sibling Codex runtime contract, should the Codex app-server lifecycle change land together with the embedded/Pi trajectory timing fix?
rationale: The branch intentionally mirrors terminal-event ownership across OpenClaw's embedded and Codex paths, but repository policy reserves the Codex contract judgment for a reviewer who has inspected the sibling implementation directly.

options.title: Verify then land together
options.body: Inspect the exact Codex lifecycle contract, refresh the branch on current main, and merge both paths if the cleanup ordering is compatible.

options.title: Narrow to embedded runs
options.body: Split out the Codex app-server changes if the upstream lifecycle has distinct terminal-event ownership or needs separate design review.

recommendation.title: Verify then land together
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact Codex lifecycle contract, refresh the branch on current main, and merge both paths if the cleanup ordering is compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only person with concrete supplied history across both modified lifecycle paths and can clarify the intended symmetry while a current-main area owner performs the contract check.
